name: Nityas Gems & Jewellery
lm_rationale: Choice Capital Advisors — chittorgarh 2026 tracker: 1 mainboard IPO (100% positive, +8.51% avg listing gain) and 3 SME IPOs (67% positive, 2 of 3 positive, +13.40% avg); combined 3 of 4 listings positive across 2026. Clears the ≥50%/≥5% Solid bar but not the ≥70%/≥15% Strong bar.
valuation_text: fair-to-rich P/E (19.38x post-issue vs RHP peer average 18.98x) and rich P/BV (4.96x)
pe_pre: 13.59 (at cap ₹75; RHP shows [●], chittorgarh states pre-issue EPS ₹5.17/P/E 14.51 on a different pre-issue share count)
net_proceeds: ₹70.00 Cr entirely for funding working capital requirements (RHP: ₹700.00 million); balance of gross proceeds after issue expenses is capped for general corporate purposes at up to 25% of gross proceeds (RHP amount left as [●] pending price finalisation).
key_risks: Consolidated operating cash flow was negative ₹147.32 million in FY26 (and negative ₹100.52 million in FY25) as inventories and trade receivables grew sharply with the business; top-10 B2B customers concentration and a working-capital-intensive model (inventory grew from ₹51.35 million in FY24 to ₹410.54 million in FY26, trade receivables from ₹40.64 million to ₹160.64 million) mean growth continues to consume cash faster than it is generated.
market_moat: Integrated B2B manufacturing (Surat facility, in-house design team of 29 with a portfolio of 32,000+ jewellery designs) plus a D2C arm via its July-2025 acquisition of Ayaani (10 stores across 8 cities); B2B customers include GIVA, Palmonas, ONYA and Ladia Diamonds; supplies to 18 states/2 UTs domestically and exports to UAE, Australia, Canada, Taiwan and Kenya.
management: Promoters Rajnikant Lallubhai Chanchad (Chairman & MD, 52.02% pre-issue), Sonalben Rajnikant Chanchad (3.98%) and Savaliya Dhruv Janakbhai (nil); combined promoter and promoter group holding is 58.10% pre-issue, falling to 43.51% post-issue.
prose_business: Surat-based lab-grown-diamond (LGD) studded gold jewellery maker, incorporated April 2022, operating an integrated B2B manufacturing/distribution model to organised retailers, standalone retailers and wholesalers, plus D2C omnichannel retail through subsidiary Ayaani Diamonds and Jewellery Pvt Ltd. Revenue grew from ₹536.55 million in FY24 to ₹2,028.94 million in FY26 (a ~94.46% 2-year CAGR per the RHP's qualitative factors section), with PAT rising from ₹40.24 million to ₹223.15 million and EBITDA margin improving from 10.21% to 15.27%.
highlight_dev: The RHP flags that lab-grown diamond jewellery is typically 60-80% cheaper than natural-diamond jewellery, and that the Indian LGD jewellery market (per the CareEdge Report cited in the RHP) grew from ₹13,738 million in CY20 to ₹34,501 million in CY25, projected to reach ₹71,890 million by CY30 (15.8% CAGR).
sector_outlook: RHP peer comparison (Basis for Issue Price, on FY26 diluted EPS and 10-Sep-2026 closing prices) shows listed LGD/diamond-jewellery peers Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery (P/E 16.61x, RoNW 18.81%), Goldiam International (P/E 21.69x, RoNW 18.38%) and Renaissance Global (P/E 18.63x, RoNW 6.09%) — average peer P/E 18.98x versus Nityas' post-issue P/E of 19.38x, i.e. priced roughly in line with peers despite far higher RoNW (43.75%).
gov_scheme: Not applicable — no Government scheme dependency disclosed for this issuer (private consumer jewellery manufacturer, unlike RHP-disclosed peer issues with Government-tender exposure).
peer_sentence: At 19.38x post-issue P/E (per chittorgarh) the issue prices roughly at the RHP-disclosed peer average of 18.98x (Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery 16.61x, Goldiam International 21.69x, Renaissance Global 18.63x), even though Nityas' FY26 RoNW of 43.75% is more than double the strongest peer's (Golkunda 18.81%).
verdict_reason: 43.75% RoNW and +128% PAT growth are exceptional, but priced near the peer average and running consolidated negative operating cash flow of ₹147.32 million in FY26 as working capital scales with growth
why: Revenue grew 109.94% to ₹203.33 Cr and PAT 128.09% to ₹22.32 Cr in FY26 (restated consolidated), with RoNW/ROCE of 43.75%/42.93% and D/E of 0.29. At ₹75 the issue prices at 19.38x post-issue EPS and 4.96x NAV, roughly level with the RHP's disclosed peer average P/E of 18.98x. The entire ₹70.00 Cr net proceeds fund working capital, a clean growth-led use, but reported operating cash flow was negative ₹147.32 million in FY26 (and negative ₹100.52 million in FY25) as inventory and receivables grew faster than profits — a classic scale-up cash-conversion risk for a working-capital-intensive B2B jewellery model. Lead manager Choice Capital's 2026 bench is Solid (3 of 4 listings positive across mainboard+SME).
suggestion: Apply for long-term growth story; priced at peer average with strong RoNW, but track negative operating cash flow and working-capital burn before expecting quick listing pop
documents: drhp-cache/nityas-gems-jewellery-rhp.pdf (Red Herring Prospectus dated September 24, 2026, 28,693 extracted text lines)
discrepancies: Chittorgarh IPO Valuation table shows Pre-IPO EPS ₹5.17 / P/E 14.51 and Post-IPO EPS ₹3.87 / P/E 19.38 (based on pre-issue shares 4,31,37,248 and post-issue 5,75,93,248); RHP's own Basis for Issue Price section shows FY26 basic/diluted EPS of ₹5.52 (weighted-avg ₹4.52) computed on a slightly different weighted-average share count used for the RHP's own quantitative-factors table — both are RHP-derived figures using different share-count bases (chittorgarh's uses the actual current pre/post-issue share count; the RHP's own EPS table uses the weighted-average shares outstanding during FY26). Chittorgarh's post-issue P/E of 19.38x is used as the headline figure since it reflects the actual pre/post-issue share count at the disclosed price band.

RHP leaves the Issue Price, Floor/Cap NAV-after-issue, and pre/post-issue P/E as [●] throughout (standard pre-price-band disclosure); ₹70-75 price band, ₹108.35 Cr issue size and 4.96 P/BV all come from chittorgarh's post-price-band figures, consistent with the 1,44,56,000-share fresh issue size disclosed in the RHP.

RHP peer table (Basis for Issue Price, p.153) uses FY26 diluted EPS and P/E as of 10-Sep-2026 closing NSE/BSE price: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery 16.61x/RoNW 18.81%, Goldiam International 21.69x/RoNW 18.38%, Renaissance Global 18.63x/RoNW 6.09% — average 18.98x. This is a genuine RHP-disclosed peer set (not invented) and is used here in place of any chittorgarh 'Check IPO Peer Comparison' link, which was not independently re-verified.

RHP's Key Performance Indicators section (p.154, in ₹ million) and Other Financial Information section (p.401, in ₹ million except per-share) both confirm FY26 EBITDA ₹309.74mn / PAT ₹223.15mn / RoNW 43.75% / NAV ₹15.13 / EBITDA margin 15.27% / PAT margin 11.00% — all consistent with chittorgarh's ₹ Cr KPI table (PAT margin, EBITDA margin, ROCE, D/E, RoNW, NAV all match after unit conversion).

Consolidated operating cash flow figures (Cash Flow from/(used in) Operating Activities, RHP p.103, in ₹ million: FY26 −147.32, FY25 −100.52, FY24 −10.51) are NOT surfaced anywhere in chittorgarh's page; added here from the RHP as a material risk factor chittorgarh's summary omits.

Chittorgarh's 'IPO Objects of the Issue' table shows only ₹70.00 Cr working capital + blank GCP row totalling ₹70.00 Cr; RHP confirms ₹700.00 million (=₹70.00 Cr) for working capital with GCP capped at ≤25% of gross proceeds, amount left [●] pending price finalisation — consistent, no discrepancy, just RHP shows the cap mechanism chittorgarh omits.
